title: Today's lessons
summary: Each day the app picks the lessons that matter most and keeps them for the day.
description: The home screen answers one question: what should I do today. The answer is a short list, not a backlog.

stories.as: a learner opening the app with ten minutes
stories.want: a short list of what matters most today
stories.soThat: I can start without deciding and stop when it is done

requirements.text: Today's lessons are chosen once a day and kept for that day; they are chosen again only when the learner changes how many lessons a day they want, or when the kept choice names no lesson this device has.
The list has `daily.default` lessons unless the learner sets another number, from 1 to 20.
Lessons that failed or were partly there last time and are due again come first.
Other due lessons follow, those most at risk first: the furthest past their interval, with lessons of lower ease ahead.
While there is room, at most `daily.max-new` new lessons a day are added, taken from the newest courses.
If a place is still free, at most `daily.max-reviews` mastered lesson whose words are due for review is added as a light review.
A review of a mastered lesson never takes the place of a due or new lesson, and cannot cost the lesson its mastery.
A mastered lesson, or one in a closed course, is never due.

history.text: A mastered lesson, or one listed only by a closed course, is never due.
history.reason: A lesson is in one course now, so no other course can keep it in play.

requirements.text: A course's challenges are offered only once its other lessons are passed.
Finishing the list is the day done, shown with a celebration; lessons due beyond the list are not shown on the home screen.
Today's lessons are the same on all of the learner's devices; if two devices chose them while apart, the later choice wins.

values.description: How many of today's lessons there are unless the learner sets another number.
